summary: Maximise button label and glyph never change; it does not track maximised state, so after maximising it still announces Развернуть while it restores
evidence: TitleBar.svelte:14 static aria-label and glyph; no isMaximized state; double-click on drag region also toggles maximise (drag.js:103)
failure_scenario: Maximised window: screen reader says Развернуть, button actually restores the window.
